provenance.coordinate_preparation: Original source identity join; established nuclear-distance Reduce protocol; zero canonical heavy-coordinate movement; no minimization or side-chain rebuilding. Original mmCIF serialization rounding is recorded in the scientific run.
provenance.score_scope: Whole-model standalone RPF scores shared across residue-selected clustering views; no per-residue RPF score is implied.
provenance.publication_scope: Scalar metrics and source hashes for the AIS CASP17 public UI; no raw scientific outputs or private paths.

metric_definitions.dp: Native printed RPF DP; negative values are retained
metric_definitions.ptm: Native AFSample3 summary_confidences.json ptm (0–1); missing stays null
